caption: Speech is a source e[n] from the vocal folds passed through the vocal tract filter h[n]; this 2 s recording at 16 kHz gives 32000 samples (64 kB), and cutting it into 25 ms frames every 10 ms gives 400-sample frames with a 160-sample hop, so 198 frames. Notice that source and filter stay separate blocks, and that the frame count comes last.

spec.title: From air to frames: the 2 s example
spec.aria: A downward flow: the lungs push air, the vocal folds pulse it into the source e[n], the vocal tract filters it into speech x[n], which is sampled at 16 kHz with 16-bit samples to give 32000 samples and 64 kB, then cut into 25 ms frames every 10 ms, giving 198 frames.
